description: This file defines the 'MasterIf' class, which implements an 'if' conditional element for a mini-language processing framework within the Apache OFBiz project. It includes logic for parsing XML elements representing conditionals and executing associated sub-operations.

classes.name: MasterIf
classes.description: Represents a conditional 'if' operation with support for 'then', 'else-if', and 'else' branches, capable of executing sub-operations based on evaluated conditions.

classes.name: MasterIfFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MasterIf from XML elements.

methods.name: MasterIf
methods.description: Constructor that parses XML element to initialize the conditional, then, else-if, and else sub-operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional logic, evaluating conditions and running corresponding sub-operations.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from sub-operations for analysis or documentation.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the condition for debugging.
